_about: ⚠ COORDINATES, NOT PHOTOGRAPHS. group_bursts consumes exactly two numbers
per consecutive pair — the gap in milliseconds and the cosine of the two
feature prints. A synthetic pair built at the MEASURED coordinates
therefore exercises the shipped code path with the measured inputs, and no
real feature-print byte and no real item id has to be committed to do it.
⚠ THE CLOCK IS THE RULE; THE SIMILARITY IS THE RAIL. The named case below
sits at cosine 0.872, which is essentially the MEDIAN of true consecutive
bursts (0.888) — so no similarity threshold could have cut it without
cutting more than half of every real burst. Only the time window excludes
it. Its control is the same cosine at 19 s, which merges: that pair is what
proves the clock is doing the work.
⚠ A5, RECORDED AND NOT DISCHARGED: no precision or recall exists for this
rule and none can be produced from existing data — #40's 247 groups are a
rule's OUTPUT, not labels, so validating against them is circular. The
owner's manual read of six sampled groups (five correct, one wrong) is the
only ground truth and it is not recorded per item anywhere reachable.
Nothing in this file claims a precision or a recall.

window_sweep._about: groups produced at each window over the 3,748 true screenshots. #40 reported 247 groups / 700 members; 20 s reproduces it at 246 and is the LARGEST window that still excludes the named false group (27 s > 20 s; at 30 s it merges).

threshold_sweep._about: links cut by T at W = 20 s, out of 496. T = 0.50 fails toward MERGING, which is D-08's ruling; T = 0.70 is a fail-toward-SPLITTING threshold in disguise.

separation._about: cosine p50 by pair class, n=1,500 sampled per class. Random pairs sit ABOVE the floor — which is why the rail is nearly inert and the plan says so out loud.

pairs.name: known_false_group
pairs.provenance: #40's ONE documented false group: `WRNS Studio` then `BccI Construction`. Reproduced here at its measured coordinates with SYNTHETIC ids and SYNTHETIC vectors — the two real item ids are deliberately absent from tests/.
pairs.why: 27,000 > 20,000. The similarity gate is structurally incapable of removing this pair: 0.872 is essentially the median of true bursts.

pairs.name: same_similarity_inside_window
pairs.provenance: the control for the case above — identical cosine, a gap inside the window.
pairs.why: this is what proves the CLOCK is doing the work and not the rail.

pairs.name: window_boundary_joins
pairs.why: the comparison is `<=`, so exactly 20,000 ms joins.

pairs.name: window_boundary_splits
pairs.why: one millisecond past the window and it does not.

pairs.name: cosine_boundary_joins
pairs.why: the comparison is `>=`, so exactly 0.50 joins, with no rounding step before it.

pairs.name: cosine_boundary_splits
pairs.why: a ten-thousandth under and it does not.

pairs.name: the_and_is_an_and
pairs.why: a one-second gap is not enough on its own — the two tests are ANDed, and this is the side of that AND the rail owns.

identity._about: V15. cos = 1 - d^2/2 on an L2-normalised print (median ||v|| = 1.0001), verified on a real pair at cos 0.7829 against 1 - d^2/2 = 0.7822 (float32 rounding). ⚠ NEVER `1 - distance` — VNGenerateImageFeaturePrintRequest.computeDistance returns a DISTANCE, and inverting it collapses exactly the photographs it should keep apart.
